title: AgriJev: Efficient Agricultural Candidate Scoring with Multi-Scale Adapted Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.19478v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agricultural systems make decisions over heterogeneous entity types, textual judgments, and knowledge-question options. Generating a textual answer adds decoding and extraction steps to decisions that ultimately require a candidate choice. We introduce AgriJev, a family of adapted Qwen3.5 models at 0.8B, 2B, 4B, and 9B. A shared interface conditions on agricultural text, a judgment question, and candidate definitions, returning scores and relative probabilities in one forward call. We prepare source-aware training records and frozen evaluations from existing agricultural resources, retaining original groups and annotation provenance. Comparisons include original Qwen3.5 models and matched agricultural SFT models, both evaluated through native answer generation. translated_title: AgriJev：基于多尺度适配模型的高效农业候选评分
translated_abstract: 农业系统需要在异构实体类型、文本判断和知识问题选项上做出决策。生成文本答案会为最终只需候选选择的决策增加额外的解码与提取步骤。我们提出AgriJev，这是一系列适配后的Qwen3.5模型，包含0.8B、2B、4B和9B四种规模。通过一个共享接口，模型以农业文本、判断问题和候选定义作为条件输入，在一次前向调用中同时返回分数和相对概率。我们基于现有农业资源构建了具有来源感知的训练数据和固定的评测集，并保留了原始分组与标注来源信息。对比实验包括原始Qwen3.5模型和匹配的农业SFT模型，两者均通过原生答案生成方式进行评估。在17个外部测试视图上，AgriJev-9B达到75.44%的平均准确率，分别超过原始生成模型和SFT生成器5.89和3.79个百分点。
tldr: AgriJev是一系列多尺度适配的Qwen3.5农业模型，通过单次前向调用直接对候选选项评分而非生成文本答案，在17个外部测试视图上平均准确率达75.44%，超越原始模型和农业SFT生成模型。
en_tdlr: AgriJev is a family of multi-scale adapted Qwen3.5 agricultural models that directly scores candidate options in a single forward call instead of generating textual answers, achieving 75.44% mean accuracy across 17 external test views and outperforming both original and SFT generation-based models.
